uses.quote: If you use Gen AI tools in your learning or assessments, you must follow university guidance and acknowledge AI-generated content.
Staff and students are expected to declare when they directly use
Any use of Gen AI in the process and writing-up of your research should be clearly acknowledged.
Your final thesis should be your own work, not AI-generated content.
Gen AI can be a valuable and enabling tool for many, enhancing understanding, productivity and accessibility, and offering particular benefits for disabled and neurodivergent individuals.

default_when_silent.quote: If you are unsure about permissible use of Gen AI in your assessments, check the Assessment Brief and ask your module leader/tutor.

decided_by.quote: You have the academic freedom to decide what use of Gen AI – if any – is permitted, on individual assessments and other learning activities.
clear guidance on Gen AI use should be included in every assessment brief as per the University Assessment Policy [forthcoming].

location.quote: Use the Assessment Gen AI Declaration sheet with students for each assessment submission.

consequence.quote: Misrepresenting AI-generated work as your own is academic misconduct and may result in an academic integrity investigation.
